body_html:
JAMMIN’ DJs NAMED WINNER IN

THE KNOT BEST OF WEDDINGS 2014

JAMMIN’ DJ’s

Denver Georgia 2014 — JAMMIN’ DJs are pleased to announce They have been selected as a 2014 ­­winner in The Knot Best of Weddings, a special section featured on TheKnot.com/BOW. TheKnot.com the number-one wedding destination, most trusted by brides.

This is the 5th year JAMMIN’ DJs has been voted the WINNER for The Knot Best of Weddings.

 

The Knot Best of Weddings 2014 provides a “by brides, for brides” guide to the top wedding professionals across the country, and is a must-have when it comes to selecting the best-of-the-best wedding resources. Whether they’re trying to find the wedding dress salon with the best service in Philadelphia, the most creative wedding photographers in Los Angeles, New York’s top cake bakers or Miami’s hottest reception sites, engaged couples across the country want the inside scoop on the best from real brides.

 

“We are truly honored to have won this prestigious award for the last 5 years and wish to continue providing the best entertainment to our clients for years to come ~ John Murray (Owner)”
